purpose: Teach: 大卒/常駐/還流/短絡/受話器/取り引き/改名/おもに

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、大卒の研究員候補をリストアップしろ
lines.en: Ren, compile a list of recent-graduate researcher candidates.
lines.style: Crisp, efficient authority. No wasted words. Eyes level, expectation clear but not unkind. The tone of someone who trusts competence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験施設に技術員を常駐させております
lines.en: Yes. We currently have technicians stationed in the experimental facility.
lines.style: Earnest report-back, slightly faster pace. Wanting to show he's already thought ahead. Respectful but not servile — the compliance of someone engaged with the work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外研究費の還流ルートを確認しろ
lines.en: Ren, verify the return flow route for overseas research funding.
lines.style: Measured directive, slightly lowered register. More weight on this one — this is a real check. Still composed, but the attention has sharpened.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究結果を短絡的に解釈しないようにします
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we don't oversimplify the research findings.
lines.style: Quiet, slightly defensive undertone — he's trying to show he understands the deeper issue. Careful pacing. Not rambling, but slightly more elaborate, like he's clarifying his thinking in real time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験室の受話器を更新しろ
lines.en: Ren, get the lab phone system updated.
lines.style: Back to efficiency. Shorter sentence — pragmatic task. Tone unchanged: clear, direct, the assumption that it will be done.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。海外機関との取り引きを学会で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I presented our dealings with overseas institutions at the conference.
lines.style: Forward motion, a touch lighter. Ren is showing initiative, reporting something he's already accomplished. Slightly less guarded than before — pride in the work showing through the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の研究プロジェクトの改名を検討中だ
lines.en: Ren, I'm considering renaming the research project for the paper.
lines.style: Informational, not quite a directive. The 'dā' ending carries weight — more like thinking aloud to someone trusted. Still composed, but the dynamic has shifted slightly toward consultation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室はおもに生体材料を扱います
lines.en: Yes. Our lab primarily works with biomaterials.
lines.style: Brief, grounded response. Understated — not overdoing it, but present. The tone of someone listening carefully and offering useful context. Respectful close to the exchange.
